messages:
sri: Heads-up: release cutoff today 5pm PT. Any last-minute code/changes? I'm planning to cut the RC after 5:15 unless there are blockers.

alex_w: One PR left — version bump + changelog. pinging @chris for one quick review.

chris: On it, will review in 10. If it's just version/changelog fine to merge.

alex_w: Thx. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821 — bump to v1.12.0
Diff snippet:
```
- version: 1.11.3
+ version: 1.12.0
```
Note: includes DB migration migration_2026_03_17.sql

sam: Heads up — integration suite flaky, failing on migrations in CI-7. I'm re-running.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline rerun triggered for PR #4821 — ~4m remaining.

chris: Merged, but leaving canary off by default. Recommend we hold full release until CI green + migration smoke locally.

sri: Ok — plan: if CI passes by 5:30 we'll proceed with a 10% canary for 30m, then full roll at 6:15. If CI still failing, we'll slip to tomorrow 10:00am PT and post notice in #announcements. Any objections?

maria: No objections. I can prep the announcement draft if we slip.

alex_w: CI passed. Rerunning smoke on my local now. Will ping when smoke complete.

alex_w: Local smoke ok. Starting canary deploy now. @sri

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: release v1.12.0 -> canary-10% (initiated by alex_w) — monitor: https://console.redwood.local/deploy/123

sam: Seeing increased 503s on canary shards, investigating. Could be nginx conn pool.

chris: If 503s > 2% for 10m we rollback. Tailing logs:
```
kubectl logs -f svc/inference-canary -n prod
```

sam: Found misconfigured cache TTL in canary config — patching now.

alex_w: Patch applied, doing a small rolling restart.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics back to baseline. 503s < 0.5%.

sri: Nice. Proceeding to full rollout in 10m. I'll post status in #announcements once started.

maria: Announcement ready: "Release v1.12.0 deployed — minor schema migration; should be transparent. Contact #support if you see issues." I'll wait for your go.

sri: Go. Posting now. Thanks everyone :tada:

deploy-bot: Announcement posted to #announcements by maria.
_meta: generated for dataset: engineering release planning slack thread
